summary: Neo wakes on the main deck and thrashes against his chair, demanding the cable be pulled from the back of his neck. Trinity calms him while Dozer holds him and Trinity unlocks the cable; once it is out, Neo tears away, trips free of the harness, and falls, recoiling from their touch. On his hands and knees he reels as the world spins, sweat pouring off him while pressure builds in his skull. He repeatedly insists he can't believe it; Cypher warns he is going to pop. Neo then vomits violently, pitches forward, and blacks out.

what_changes.before: Waking in panic, thrashing to rip the cable from the back of his neck and rejecting anyone who touches him.
what_changes.after: Physically overwhelmed by the return to his body, he vomits and blacks out.
what_changes.evidence: Vomiting violently, Neo pitches forward and blacks out.

what_changes.before: Resisting what he has just been shown about the real world.
what_changes.after: Struggling to accept the truth, repeating his disbelief as his body reacts.
what_changes.evidence: NEO / I don't believe it!  I don't / believe it!

event_hint.one_line: Neo is unplugged and wakes on the Nebuchadnezzar's main deck, reeling from the shock of the real world.

uncertain: Whether Dozer speaks at all in this scene.
The exact identity of the "chair" and harness beyond being part of the unplug apparatus.
